metadata.title: Fresh e-GP getProcureResult extraction for FY 2569 TMD S-band radar tenders
metadata.evidence_rule: Project ID and station are kept together; no station-price remapping is performed after extraction.
metadata.technical_reason_note: The public getProcureResult response exposes submitted price, resultFlag, and agreed price. It does not expose the written reason for a qualification/technical failure. Those reports remain an information gap.
